A month has passed, and I still haven't received it. Could you please let me know when I will receive my card? I have been going to my bank to withdraw money, but I don't always have time to wait in long queues. It would be much more convenient for me to use the ATM near my office. If I had an ATM card, I could withdraw money on my way to work. Would you please also send me a brochure about your telephone banking services? If I could check my account balance by telephone, I would save a lot of time. Thank you for your help. Yours sincerely, Ali Al Turki
